boundedAssessments.prep11.discovery: Bounded official Help 10.6 introduction, September 30 Platform blog and September 15 Cisco announcement review plus version-specific searches on help.splunk.com, splunk.com/en_us/blog and newsroom.cisco.com found no qualifying public Enterprise 11.x release statement. This is a bounded discovery result, not absence or compatibility proof. Current 10.6 release and four-segment versioning remain current-release context.
boundedAssessments.prep11.operator: Help matrix 3.2: September 24, 2026; Kubernetes 1.32–1.37; Enterprise 10.0.12–10.6.0. Changelog 3.2.0: September 8; Kubernetes 1.32–1.36; Enterprise 10.6.0. Both tuple/date readings and the queue secretKeyRef versus volList breaking change remain distinct. Neither certifies 11.x.
boundedAssessments.prep11.architecture: Deployment Options/Storage/Resilience support single-site S1, C1/C11, C3/C13 and discourage nonredundant D1/D11. Multi-site is within one region with namespace constraints. SmartStore, persistent hot/cache/config volumes, storage-dependent durability and PDB/probe recovery do not establish cross-region DR or 11.x requirements.
boundedAssessments.prep11.app-delivery: Application Lifecycle Management/App Framework/Premium Apps assessed separately from architecture: external object storage, read-only credentials, TLS 1.2 minimum and persistent Operator state. No automatic app deletion; some manual restarts; content and compatibility validation remain external. ES supplemental TA distribution and ITSI supported add-ons remain separate current-release requirements.
boundedAssessments.prep11.workload: Exact 10.6 Workload management modes/activation/status/Web sections: 10.4+ Kubernetes Basic is admission-only, Advanced requires writable CPU/memory cgroups and supports full pools/rules. allow_basic=false is the default; Basic needs explicit true. Basic does not load categories/pools, and listing admission rules requires search_filter. Expected Advanced preflight warnings do not make intentionally configured Basic misconfigured. No 11.x promise.
boundedAssessments.prep11.cloud-option: Readiness staffing, communications and post-migration transition sections require a prepared team, audience-specific communication, existing channels/feedback and an operating-model plan. Value steward/platform optimizer/redeployment/reflection options are not guaranteed staff reductions or Cloud rollout/authorization.
boundedAssessments.prep11.context-versioning: September 30 blog, Keep Apps and Integrations Ready for Updated Versioning: use supported product identification rather than version-number-only Enterprise/Cloud detection. This is 10.6 context, not an 11.x announcement or path.
boundedAssessments.prep11.context-ai: September 15 Cisco Self-managed Splunk AI section: NVIDIA AI POD Kubernetes infrastructure available today, AI Assistant available now, Agent Launchpad planned later in 2026. Adjacent infrastructure and a plan do not establish Enterprise 11.x architecture or actual later delivery. Direct Cisco denial retained; substantive exact official indexed body assessed.
